_note: Episode 26 (S3E6), the vision-journey episode (SERIES.md, "The vision-journey episode"). Upper Amazon (Ucayali, Peru), a ceremony under the care of Maestra Adela, an invented Shipibo-Konibo healer shown with respect. Frames: no drinking in close-up (the cup only at a distance, k90+ "cup_far"), nobody being sick in detail (a dark silhouette only), the visions painted as glowing kené-style geometric line patterns seen through his eyes; no plant, no brew preparation, no drug words in prompts. M always fully clothed in her long dark coat. Usman appears only inside the vision (white light). Copied from Episode 11: full/intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
